Newer versions of all thirteen apps on a fresh Selkies base.

## ⚡ Improved
- **Newer apps:** CADCraft 0.12.0, DeckCraft 0.10.0, DesignCraft 0.12.0, EffectCraft 0.16.0, FigCraft 0.10.0, FilmCraft 0.12.0, GridCraft 0.11.1, LightCraft 0.13.0, PdfCraft 0.13.0, PhotoCraft 0.14.0, SoundCraft 0.12.1, VectorCraft 0.16.0 and WordCraft 0.10.0. Each still installs the official `.deb`, checked against its release's `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
- **Updated base image:** the LinuxServer Selkies base moves to its latest build, with Ubuntu's current security updates.

## 🐛 Fixed
- **Docker Hub pages:** every app's Docker Hub repository shows the README and a one-line description of the app instead of an empty page.
